fact: The May 2024 feasibility study found Guinea-Bissau has no national strategy, no national CERT or equivalent and no assessment of critical assets, and no obligation for public or private entities to report security incidents.
title: Relatório de Modelos de Governança: Estudo de viabilidade sobre Modelos de Governança de Cibersegurança e Proteção de Dados
publisher: BS Innovations & GoSecure for WARDIP Guiné-Bissau
